articles.title: Houthi Artillery Shelling Injures Couple in Rural Taiz
articles.description: TAIZ-SABA A civilian and his wife were injured early Thursday when Houthi militia artillery shelling targeted villages in Al-Aqroudh district, south of Taiz province, damaging several homes and spreading fear among residents. Local sources told the Yemeni News Agency (Saba) that the indiscriminate overnight shelling struck civilian homes, injuring Mohammed Ibrahim Saeed Hassan and his wife, Maria Abdu Ahmed Abduljaleel, with shrapnel. Three houses also sustained partial damage. The sources said the shelling caused panic among residents, who were awakened by the sound of explosions, as Houthi militias continued to target villages and residential areas with artillery fire.
